meta.title: Novel Shelf
meta.description: Keep a local txt novel open in the DSH right sidebar while you work on a project — three novels ship bundled so a fresh install already has a shelf, and shelf, progress and theme are shared with the desktop novel-reader app. New in v0.2.0: an AI companion that comments on whatever you just read, with a character floating in the corner; pick any model provider registered in DSH or point it at your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint and API key.
